name: TextCaps: Image Captioning with Reading Comprehension
description: TextCaps is an image captioning benchmark that requires vision-language models to read, recognize, and comprehend text present in images to generate accurate natural language descriptions. It features 28,408 real-world images from the Open Images dataset paired with 142,040 human-written captions (5 captions per image), presenting a rigorous challenge for OCR-grounded scene reasoning.
